title: Romantic Hideaway / Near Downtown & Stadium
description:
Your private Nashville retreat, just 7 miles from Downtown! 

Unwind in a beautiful clawfoot tub, cozy up by the fireplace, or enjoy an evening around the outdoor fire pit.

Guests consistently rave about the spotless space, peaceful setting, and incredibly comfortable king bed. 

Located in a quiet historic neighborhood with easy access to Broadway, Music Row, and Nissan Stadium, perfect for a romantic getaway or relaxing Nashville stay.

The space
Welcome to your private studio suite in a historic Nashville neighborhood! Guests say this is the perfect mix of quiet retreat and close-to-downtown convenience.

🛋 What you’ll enjoy
•	Spacious master suite with clawfoot tub & fireplace
•	Outdoor fire pit for cozy evenings
•	Ultra-comfortable bed (guests rave about their sleep!)
•	Private parking and your own entrance
•	Peaceful setting with sheep, deer and turkey sightings, yet just minutes to Broadway

📍 Distances to attractions
•	Broadway Honky Tonks – 5 miles
•	Nissan Stadium – 4 miles
•	Music Row – 6.5 miles
•	Grand Ole Opry – 11 miles
•	Nashville Airport – 9.3 miles
•	Columbia, Franklin, & other charming towns are 20–40 minutes away for easy day trips

💡 Insider Tip: Most guests grab Lyft/Uber to Broadway—just $15–$17 on weekend nights.

Guest access
Enjoy complete privacy with your own private entrance and dedicated guest space. 

Your outdoor fire pit is just steps from your front door. 

The homeowner lives right next door and is available if you need anything during your stay, while giving you complete privacy to enjoy your space.

Other things to note
To help us maintain a clean, comfortable space for all guests, we’re unable to accommodate pets. Thank you for understanding!
